# Mainnet aETH/aUSD native fixtures

`native-buy.json` is a separate regular PropAMM Buy fixture generated by
`generate-native-buy.rs` against PropAMM
`6d700698691113117252d3e896707de88574979a` and Arch/APL 0.13.0. It spends
1,000,000 aUSD base units for a nominal 400,000 aETH base units, with a 396,000
minimum, native quote signer and no bridge instructions. Its signed size is
696 bytes. The existing treasury-buy fixture below is retained for compatibility.

`transactions.json` contains deterministic, unsigned buy/sell transactions built
from prop-amm's `minting` revision
`de11093e3291c4d18ec211a85038c7e7c80301b3` using Arch SDK/program `0.13.0`:

- Buy: `server/src/treasury_mint.rs::buy_instructions` emits an APL transfer
  (tag 3, 9 bytes, 3 accounts), then bridge `MintFromTreasury` (tag 21,
  73 bytes, 11 accounts). The second signer is the treasury authority.
- Sell: `program/src/instruction.rs::execute_trade_instruction` emits compact
  `ExecuteTrade` (tag 2, side 1, 50 bytes including `min_out`, 13 accounts).
  The second signer is the PropAMM quote signer.

`generate.rs` calls these Rust builders, their native PDA helpers and
`ArchMessage::new`; the TypeScript tests decode and reserialize their original
bytes. The standalone exporter supplies only the server error type needed to
compile `treasury_mint.rs` outside the server binary.

Mainnet program/mint identities were refreshed against the 2026-11-03 deployment
(aETH `7g1nPC…`, 9 decimals; bridge `F5uRFV…`; treasury authority `GPoZuM…`). The
[treasury deployment evidence](../treasury-mainnet-v2/README.md) records the quote,
on-chain asset authorization, mint authority and matching published bridge IDL.
The user, blockhash, mint ID, quote
amounts and time are test values. No private keys or signatures are included.
The fixed clock is `1800000000000` ms and expiry is 30 seconds later. These
fixtures are for offline ABI tests, not transaction submission.

At an illustrative price of 2,500 aUSD per aETH, the buy spends 1 aUSD for
400,000 aETH base units; the sell spends 1,000,000 aETH base units for 2.5 aUSD, with
a 1% output minimum. aETH has 9 decimals and aUSD has 6. Amount strings represent
integer base units, and `signed_size` counts two placeholder signatures.

## Regenerate

Run from the SDK root with the pinned revision available in the local PropAMM
repository. This creates only a temporary Rust build directory and the fixture
JSON; the server checkout is read-only. Cargo dependencies must be cached for
`--offline`.

```bash
fixture_sdk="$PWD"
fixture_propamm_repo="$HOME/Arch/prop-amm"
fixture_build=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aeth-usd-fixtures.XXXXXX)
fixture_source=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aeth-usd-propamm.XXXXXX)
mkdir -p "$fixture_build/src" "$fixture_source"
git -C "$fixture_propamm_repo" archive de11093e3291c4d18ec211a85038c7e7c80301b3 | tar -x -C "$fixture_source"
cp "$fixture_sdk/tests/fixtures/aeth-usd/generate.rs" "$fixture_build/src/main.rs"
cp "$fixture_source/server/src/treasury_mint.rs" "$fixture_build/src/treasury_mint.rs"
cat > "$fixture_build/Cargo.toml" <<EOF
[package]
name = "aeth-usd-fixture-generator"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
[workspace]
[dependencies]
arch_program = "=0.13.0"
arch_sdk = "=0.13.0"
apl-token = { version = "=0.13.0", features = ["no-entrypoint"] }
apl-associated-token-account = { version = "=0.13.0", features = ["no-entrypoint"] }
propammprogram = { path = "$fixture_source/program", features = ["no-entrypoint"] }
serde_json = "1"
hex = "0.4"
EOF
cargo run --offline --manifest-path "$fixture_build/Cargo.toml" -- "$fixture_sdk/tests/fixtures/aeth-usd/transactions.json"
```

To regenerate the regular buy, use a fresh temporary project:

```bash
fixture_sdk="$PWD"
fixture_propamm_repo="$HOME/Arch/prop-amm"
fixture_build=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aeth-native-buy.XXXXXX)
fixture_source=$(mktemp -d /tmp/aeth-native-buy-propamm.XXXXXX)
mkdir -p "$fixture_build/src" "$fixture_source"
git -C "$fixture_propamm_repo" archive 6d700698691113117252d3e896707de88574979a | tar -x -C "$fixture_source"
cp "$fixture_sdk/tests/fixtures/aeth-usd/generate-native-buy.rs" "$fixture_build/src/main.rs"
cat > "$fixture_build/Cargo.toml" <<EOF
[package]
name = "aeth-native-buy-generator"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
[workspace]
[dependencies]
arch_program = "=0.13.0"
arch_sdk = "=0.13.0"
apl-token = { version = "=0.13.0", features = ["no-entrypoint"] }
propammprogram = { path = "$fixture_source/program", features = ["no-entrypoint"] }
serde_json = "1"
hex = "0.4"
EOF
cargo run --offline --manifest-path "$fixture_build/Cargo.toml" -- "$fixture_sdk/tests/fixtures/aeth-usd/native-buy.json"
```
